Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: DILG says Bato has 1 week to surrender, offers P50-M reward for arrest

blocks.text: The Department for the Interior and Local Government and the Philippine National Police set a deadline of one week for International Criminal Court suspect Senator Bato dela Rosa to surrender.

items: Paolo Duterte files cyber libel complaint vs GMA Network over Gracioso report

blocks.text: Davao City 1st District Representative Paolo Duterte files a cyber libel complaint against officials and journalists of GMA Network.

items: Red flags in 2027 agri budget: Coordinates at sea, ‘overpriced’ infra projects

blocks.text: Civil society group People’s Budget Coalition raises red flags during the Senate finance committee hearing on the proposed 2027 budget of the Department of Agriculture.

items: Millions of hacking attempts as companies, governments rush to patch PHP flaws

blocks.text: Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday, October 22, to patch critical flaws in the widely-used PHP programming language.

items: Alex Eala bows out of Ningbo Open after loss vs Diana Shnaider

blocks.text: Alex Eala bows out of the Ningbo Open after conceding to sixth seed Diana Shnaider, 5-6, 4-6. – Rappler.com
